news.title: Cruel ‘reality check’ key for Tillies stars to elevate World Cup auditions
news.lede: A cruel “reality check” from Germany could be the awakening the Matildas need heading into the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup, according to Craig Foster. Joe Montemurro needed little time to see the weaknesses in his team’s tactics, as Australia’s beloved national team suffered a 4-2 loss to Germany on Saturday. Germany celebrate after their fourth goal against the Matildas. Germany needed half an hour to find the back of the net twice, with countless chances presented before those two goals also.

news.title: Football: Soccer-US will learn from bruising friendly defeat by Spain, says Hayes
news.lede: Oct 10 (Reuters) - US women's coach Emma ⁠Hayes shook off a dismal 2-0 defeat on Saturday in the first of ⁠two friendlies against Spain, with the Americans building towards next month's World Cup ‌qualifiers. The match between top-ranked Spain and the Olympic champions was billed as a marquee showdown but the visitors took control as Patri Guijarro and Eva Navarro scored inside 15 minutes. Spain's AdrianaNanclares saved a second-half penalty from Lily ​Yohannes to keep a clean sheet for the world ⁠champions. "When you play the best team ⁠in the world you have to execute everything really well in the first instance," said Hayes.

news.title: OPINION: Will Kenya ever play in the FIFA World Cup?
news.lede: Every four years, millions of Kenyans passionately follow the FIFA World Cup. We wear the jerseys of Argentina, Brazil, France, England, Germany, Spain or Morocco. We celebrate goals, debate tactics and dream that perhaps one day Kenya will also be part of football's greatest stage.

news.title: Argentina were World Cup’s most targeted team online, says FIFA report
news.lede: Argentina were the most targeted national team on social media during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with accusations of referee favouritism, corruption and xenophobia among the main forms of abuse directed at the side, a FIFA report published on October 9 noted. The governing body’s Social Media Protection Service (SMPS) analysed more than 17.1 million posts and comments on X, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok between June 9 and July 20. Of those, 477,000 were referred for human review, with 240,000 verified as abusive. England were the second-most targeted team, followed by Spain, Brazil and Norway, the report found.

news.title: Finland beat Serbia women 3-1 in Tampere World Cup playoff
news.lede: Finland captain Ema Koivisto rose highest to meet a cross in the 28th minute in Tampere and put her side ahead against Serbia's women. Eight minutes later, Lota Lindstrom doubled the lead after a solo run, with goalkeeper Milica Kostic powerless to stop it. Finland went into halftime two goals up in the first leg of the first round of the 2027 World Cup playoff, and Serbia ended up losing 3-1. Who started for Serbia in Tampere?

news.title: AFC Plans to Launch Asian Nations League in 2030 with New World Cup Qualification Format
news.lede: The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) is considering launching a Nations League in 2030 as part of a major overhaul of the qualification systems for the FIFA World Cup and AFC Asian Cup. As reported by İdman.Biz, citing ESPN, the proposed competition would follow a model similar to the UEFA Nations League, introducing a structured league system with promotion and relegation. The tournament would take place every two years, with 47 national teams divided into three divisions. The top two divisions would each feature 18 teams, while the third would consist of 11 national sides.
